title: Extreme points, positive Grothendieck constants and tensor product norms
summary: We study several interrelated problems arising from the interplay between extreme point theory, Grothendieck-type inequalities, and tensor product norms. We develop a general framework for characterizing the extreme points of the set of positive contractions $\mathcal{A}_{X\to Y}$ between finite-dimensional Banach spaces, with explicit results for $X=\ell_1^n$, $Y=\ell_\infty^n$ and vice versa.
